test_title: PYST 4: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 02 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the following sentence in passive voice.**

Your mother teaches us English literature.

options.text: English literature is taught to us by your mother.
English literature has been taught to us by your mother.
Your mother is taught to us English literature.
English literature taught to us by your mother.

solution:
The correct answer is: **English literature is taught to us by your mother.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passive voice is formed by rearranging the sentence structure to emphasize the recipient of the action rather than the doe
